summary.en: Spectrum representations, spatial associations and uncertainty-aware analysis across proteomics and metabolomics.
summary.zh: 关注谱图表征、空间关联，以及蛋白组和代谢组分析中的不确定性。

en: This selection examines reusable spectrum representations, complementary spatial patterns and uncertainty in quantification and annotation. MSstats+ receives expanded journal validation; MassBank Human is a preprint.
Quality-aware missingness models and annotation-error calibration deserve closer reading. Some publisher full texts and feeds were unavailable; each entry states the evidence read.
zh: 本日关注可复用的谱图表征、互补空间分布，以及定量与注释中的不确定性。MSstats+ 的期刊版本扩展了验证范围；MassBank Human 仍为预印本。
值得深入的是结合质量信息的缺失值模型，以及注释错误率的校准。部分出版社全文和目录未能访问，各篇已注明实际阅读范围。

papers.title: Accounting for longitudinal peak quality metrics with MSstats+ enhances differential analysis in proteomic experiments with data-independent acquisition

read_scope.en: Abstract and publisher metadata; journal full text not read
read_scope.zh: 摘要及出版社元数据；未读期刊全文

commentary.en: MSstats+ combines DIA intensities with peak-quality metrics and their run-order profiles to downweight unreliable measurements, including imputed values, during differential analysis. This journal version expands the abstract’s validation from four experiments to five, including a second clinical study, and explicitly includes DIA-NN alongside Spectronaut; quantitative gains and detailed validation conditions were not verified from full text.
commentary.zh: MSstats+ 将 DIA 强度、色谱峰质量指标及其随进样顺序的变化结合起来，在差异分析中降低不可靠测量值及插补值的权重。相比预印本，期刊版摘要中的验证由四项实验扩展至五项，增加了第二项临床研究，并明确列出 DIA-NN 与 Spectronaut；具体性能增益和验证条件尚未通过全文核实。

papers.title: MassBank Human: The annotated human metabolome

publication_status.zh: 预印本第 1 版，未经同行评审

read_scope.en: bioRxiv abstract, metadata and repository README; manuscript not read
read_scope.zh: bioRxiv 摘要、元数据及仓库 README；未读稿件全文

commentary.en: MassBank Human condenses 36.5 million spectra from 76 public human datasets into 203,886 curated spectra and combines three annotation tools through Zipf-Bayesian rank aggregation with reported FDR control. The preprint reports 14,198 spectra with planar-structure annotations and an increase in colorectal-cancer-cell annotation coverage from 10.6% to 21.2%. Reusable spectra and uncertainty-aware aggregation are promising, but spectrum counts are not unique compounds or confirmed identities, and the FDR calibration and library–test independence remain unchecked here.
commentary.zh: MassBank Human 将 76 个公开人体数据集的约 3650 万张谱整理为 203,886 张高质量谱，并通过 Zipf–贝叶斯秩聚合整合三种注释工具，报告了 FDR 控制。预印本报告 14,198 张谱获得平面结构注释，结直肠癌细胞分析中的结构注释覆盖率由 10.6% 增至 21.2%。可复用谱库与不确定性感知的聚合值得关注，但谱图数不等于独立化合物数或确证身份，本次未核验 FDR 校准及谱库与测试数据的独立性。

papers.title: Beyond Co-Localization: DeepCoEx Learns Exclusion-Aware Spatial Representations in Mass Spectrometry Imaging via Dual-Contrastive Learning

publication_status.en: Peer-reviewed journal version, online ahead of issue
publication_status.zh: 同行评审正式期刊版，在线先行发表

read_scope.en: Publisher-deposited abstract and metadata; full text not read
read_scope.zh: 出版社提交的摘要及元数据；未读全文

commentary.en: DeepCoEx uses dual-contrastive learning to retain spatial consistency while distinguishing complementary ion distributions, reducing reliance on labeled negative pairs. The abstract reports more consistent retrieval than conventional similarity and dimensionality-reduction baselines, illustrated in rat brain and barley seeds. Modeling spatial exclusion alongside co-localization is useful, but these associations do not establish biochemical antagonism; numerical performance and robustness were not verified here.
commentary.zh: DeepCoEx 通过双重对比学习保持空间一致性，同时区分互补的离子分布，减少对空间负关联样本标注的依赖。摘要报告其检索结果比传统相似性及降维基线更一致，并以大鼠脑和大麦种子为例展示。将空间排斥与共定位一起建模值得借鉴，但空间关联不能证明生化拮抗，本次未核实数值性能与稳健性。

papers.title: Pretrained spectrum representations for diverse tandem mass spectrometry proteomics tasks

read_scope.en: Abstract and publisher metadata; journal full text not read
read_scope.zh: 摘要及出版社元数据；未读期刊全文

commentary.en: The Casanovo-based framework reuses a de novo sequencing encoder for spectrum-quality, chimericity, phosphorylation and glycosylation prediction, then improves task performance through fine-tuning. These are spectrum-level prediction tasks rather than demonstrated improvements in identification or PTM-site localization; the abstract does not establish transfer across arbitrary instruments or acquisition settings.
commentary.zh: 这一基于 Casanovo 的框架将从头测序编码器复用于谱图质量、嵌合性、磷酸化及糖基化预测，并通过微调提升任务表现。这些属于谱图层面的预测任务，不能直接等同于鉴定率或修饰位点定位能力的提升；摘要也未证明其可泛化至任意仪器与采集条件。

papers.title: Empirical-Bayes and Bayesian Hierarchical Modelling for Missingness and Differential Expression in Proteomics

read_scope.en: Abstract and publisher metadata; journal full text not read
read_scope.zh: 摘要及出版社元数据；未读期刊全文

commentary.en: missBayes models observed intensities and intensity-dependent missingness jointly, using empirical Bayes estimation and posterior sampling rather than filling in fixed values before differential analysis. The publisher reports comparison against ten workflows; inference remains conditional on the missingness model, and the accessible text does not establish universally better performance or computational cost.
commentary.zh: missBayes 对观测强度与强度依赖的缺失机制进行联合建模，通过经验贝叶斯估计和后验采样开展差异分析，而非先填入固定插补值。出版方称其与十种流程进行了比较；推断仍依赖缺失机制假设，可访问文本不足以证明其全面优于其他方法或评估计算开销。

papers.title: NuXLApp: Interactive data analysis and visualization for protein-nucleic acid crosslinking mass spectrometry

read_scope.en: Abstract and publisher metadata; journal full text not read
read_scope.zh: 摘要及出版社元数据；未读期刊全文

commentary.en: NuXLApp brings protein–RNA/DNA crosslink searches, peptide-property-based rescoring, crosslink-aware visualization and DIA-library generation into one workflow. Its contribution is practical integration for discovery and quantitative follow-up; the accessible abstract does not establish benchmark gains or site-level error calibration.
commentary.zh: NuXLApp 将蛋白质–RNA/DNA 交联检索、基于肽段性质预测的重评分、交联谱图可视化及 DIA 谱库生成整合到同一工作流中。其价值在于贯通发现与定量后续实验；可访问摘要不足以核实性能增益或位点层面的错误率校准。

papers.title: Unlabelled Spatial Metabolic Covariance Analysis (US-MCA) Reveals Tumor-Associated Reorganization of Interorgan Choline Metabolic Response Patterns in Lung Cancer

publication_status.en: Peer-reviewed journal version, online ahead of issue
publication_status.zh: 同行评审正式期刊版，在线先行发表

read_scope.en: Publisher-deposited abstract and metadata; full text not read
read_scope.zh: 出版社提交的摘要及元数据；未读全文

commentary.en: US-MCA combines whole-body AFADESI-MSI with perturbation-based, semi-quantitative covariance analysis to compare interorgan metabolic responses. D9-choline tracing supported concordant patterns for reliably detected choline-derived signals, with limited coverage of downstream one-carbon metabolites. The transferable element is spatial response coordination; the study does not establish biochemical flux, instantaneous rates or direct interorgan transport.
commentary.zh: US-MCA 将全身 AFADESI-MSI 与扰动后的半定量协变分析结合，用于比较跨器官代谢响应。D9-胆碱示踪在可靠检出的胆碱衍生信号中支持一致的响应模式，但下游一碳代谢物覆盖有限。可借鉴的是空间响应协调性的分析框架，研究并未测定生化通量、瞬时反应速率或直接跨器官运输。

papers.title: Parameter-Based Prioritization of Time-Resolved LC–HRMS Ion Tracks for Untargeted Reaction Monitoring

read_scope.en: Indexed publisher text: selected Methods, Results and Limitations; supplements not read
read_scope.zh: 出版社索引文本中的部分方法、结果与局限；未读补充材料

commentary.en: This Java workflow filters time-resolved m/z–intensity tracks using intensity, correlation, MinMax and early-change descriptors, retaining 29 tracks across three naringenin–ABTS reaction replicates. Its transparent trajectory prioritization complements existing LC–MS processing, but it omits chromatographic alignment, MS/MS, isotope and adduct relationships, so tracks need not represent distinct compounds. Thresholds were tuned to one reaction system, and chemical false-positive/negative rates were not established.
commentary.zh: 该 Java 工作流以强度、相关性、MinMax 和早期变化等指标筛选时间分辨 m/z–强度轨迹，在三次柚皮素–ABTS 反应重复中保留 29 条轨迹。其透明的轨迹筛选可补充现有 LC–MS 处理，但不包含色谱对齐、MS/MS、同位素或加合物关系，轨迹不一定代表独立化合物。阈值针对单一反应体系调节，尚未确立化学假阳性或假阴性率。
